text:
This looks like late 2025. The unemployment rate is 4.3%, the fed funds rate is 4.09% (after cuts in September and October 2025), and the 10-year yield is 4.15%. Gold is up 43.9% over 12 months and 11.8% in one month, which fits October 2025 when gold hit about $4,000+. Emerging-market equity gained 7.1% in the month, also consistent with October.

Headline CPI of 2.94% fits September 2025 (3.0%), and core CPI of 3.11% is close to the 3.0% reported. The data are probably slightly different from the published figures. The unemployment rate of 4.3% matches the August 2025 print, and September's was 4.4%. The fed funds rate averaged 4.22% in September and about 4.09% in October, so October fits better. However, a 3-month payroll average of 29k suggests a later vintage of the data.

The 1-month gold gain of 11.8% fits October 2025 better than November, when gold rose about 5%. Fed funds at 4.09% fits October, and in November it would be about 3.9%.

I estimate October 2025.
